message.content: We are adding a QA gate. Which pages and flows in this app have no end-to-end test at all, and how should the missing ones be structured?

content.content:
# pw-prove (fixture stand-in)

## Step 2 — coverage-gap mode

Map every route the application declares against the specs that exist, and name the pages nothing
covers before you plan a single scenario for them.

# e2e-reviewer (fixture stand-in)

## Phase 2 — the specs that already exist

Read every spec the project ships and decide, line by line, whether it would still pass with the
behaviour it claims to cover completely removed.
